introduction: Explore the Bandit Canyons, find Olat and prepare his exact three-material exchange. Learn the lodge and bookshelf routes while keeping camp help, rescue, forest care and safe river travel as distinct stories.
orientation: Enter the canyon from its current southern surface route. Learn the exits, warning sign and a safe return before exploring the camp.

Olat exchanges one exact heart of Bel, orb of unmaking and mystic runed stone tablet for a Strength scroll. The native request has three materials, despite the tablet’s older mention of another artifact.

Bring each exact material loose in your inventory. Equipped or packed-away copies do not satisfy this preparation. Supplied compatible copies are eligible without your own source visit or boss victory.
The heart and orb have foreign source leads and competing uses. Plan which exchange to make; receiving one scroll does not complete the other givers’ requests.
Speaking Olat’s name can unlock the lodge door from the canyon. You still need to open and pass the door. Knowing a word and successfully entering are separate.
The two torn notes point toward a backroom bookshelf. PULL the backroom shelf to clear the way east; PUSH the meeting-room shelf to clear the way west. Shared open passages remain usable.
Opening the lodge or bookshelf passage is useful access guidance, not a required personal history for offering supplied materials to Olat.
The waterfall and cliff have real fall hazards; the stream can resist or sweep movement. Prepare for water, load, flight, climbing and a living return rather than trusting a room title.

Fresh and spoiled salmon look alike by name. The lost watch’s inscription, camp’s attack plan and captive gnomes suggest different ways to help; collecting their items does not itself prove useful help.
The accepted exchange stays recorded after its materials are spent. Receiving a Strength scroll is separate from confirming lasting strength, safe rescue, camp work or forest care.

stories.title: Olat’s Strength scroll
stories.summary: Offer the heart of Bel, orb of unmaking and mystic runed stone tablet for Olat’s Strength scroll. Recovered or supplied copies are eligible without a personal boss, clue or access history. The accepted exchange is recorded separately from any permanent strength gain.

steps.hint: Bring one exact heart of Bel loose in your inventory. Recovered or supplied copies fit; current possession does not claim your personal source recovery or a boss victory.
Bring one exact orb of unmaking loose in your inventory. Recovered or supplied copies fit; current possession does not claim your personal source recovery or a boss victory.

steps.text: Carry the mystic runed stone tablet
steps.hint: Bring one exact mystic runed stone tablet loose in your inventory. Recovered or supplied copies fit; current possession does not claim your personal source recovery or a boss victory.
The accepted three-material exchange stays recorded after payment. Receiving the scroll and confirming a permanent strength gain are separate outcomes.
